release_notes: Landing and local-offer assets get a guaranteed-load path: served HTML is rewritten so absolute asset paths (/css/style.css) become relative and survive the base tag, a JS polyfill keeps anchor smooth-scrolling intact, the referer fallback now resolves campaign URLs (/bd86o7dw) to their landing or offer by parsing stream settings instead of only /lander/<slug>, and when the nginx /_internal_assets location is missing the tracker detects it and streams assets directly from PHP with Range/206 support instead of failing. Domain settings gain an explicit SSL mode selector — Let's Encrypt, Cloudflare (the generated vhost restores the visitor's real IP from Cloudflare ranges and honours CF-Visitor for HTTPS), or Custom certificate paths; UI strings ship in all 7 languages. install.sh runs smoke tests after install (internal-assets location, ACME webroot, self-signed cert, nginx syntax) and cli/check_landings.php diagnoses permissions, nginx completeness, ACME accessibility and SSL presence. The bulk .txt/.csv import buttons are removed from Campaigns, Offers, Landings and Traffic Sources by design. AN EXISTING NGINX SERVER SHOULD RE-RUN `sudo php /var/www/orbitra/cli/nginx_sync.php` ONCE for the Cloudflare-aware vhost blocks.
